usedFor: Mailtrap holds inbound email and HubSpot holds deals, so “New Email Received” can run “Create Deal” for each enquiry.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Received” in Mailtrap, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The trigger carries sender, recipients and subject, so a deal can start from a real inbound message.

watchOut: “Create Deal” on “New Email Opened” would make deals from opens, not enquiries, so use “New Email Received”.
